propositions: TestClient entering the review-bot ASGI lifespan in tests inherited the production 1200-second shutdown drain, causing unit tests to hang or run long background reconciliation and janitor sweeps
The production default SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=1200 must remain unchanged in src/rebar/review_bot/config.py
Every pytest test must receive a bounded SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS=1.0 baseline via autouse fixture to prevent lifespan background tasks from blocking
Tests must be able to opt into the real reconcile_loop and background janitor selectively via markers or explicit fixture bypasses while keeping defaults safe
A test-local SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS override must take precedence over the suite-wide 1.0 baseline to support purpose-specific test scenarios
